_comment: Goldens for the intent suite (Grand Plan Phase 16, step 5): the intent step reads a learner's
message before tool choice. kind: question | look_up | action | change | handoff | chat.
multiStep (optional): the reading must say it takes more than one step. handoff cases are the
coordination half: a session, the teaching guide or another learner's agent should take over.
thresholdNote: A misread kind sends the agent to the wrong kind of tool; a few borderline readings are tolerable.
